connection_points.basis: Each cooling pod joins the facility trunk at its own tee and takes the nearest declared facility connection point with capacity for its whole primary flow.
connection_points.scope: Geometric and flow-capacity assignment only. No pressure, control-valve authority or plant staging check.

metadata.pod_relocation_scope: Moved each pod with its own TCS and FWS collectors and relinked it to the facility trunk. Reconnected routes require collision/ceiling review.

heat_ledger.basis: Coincident declared IT heat, with no diversity: liquid to CDUs; residual compute, network and additional room/fan heat to air units. Each load is counted once.
heat_ledger.unassigned: Envelope, ventilation, latent and fan/motor gains are excluded unless entered in additional_air_load_W. Air coil performance and FWS temperature compatibility require selection.

source_refs.applicability: Combined air/liquid cooling system architecture; unit geometry and loss allocations are project assumptions

air_cooling.architecture: Parallel two-port CRAH/wall-coil branches on FWS; aggregate air-side heat only.
air_cooling.temperature_status: UNRESOLVED: selected FWS temperature may be too warm for the required air supply; select a compatible coil or design a separate chilled-water circuit.

source_refs.applicability: Combined air/liquid cooling system architecture; unit geometry and loss allocations are project assumptions

plant.capacity_status: NOT_EVALUABLE: manufacturer ratings and minimum-flow controls unassigned

unresolved.detail: Air coils share the declared FWS supply. Verify entering water/air conditions with the coil vendor; warm CDU facility water may require a separate chilled-water circuit for air cooling.

assumptions.K_reference: Selected local bore; reducer uses smaller connected bore
assumptions.flow_sharing: All modeled units share equally within their assigned pod or plant bank; installed spare units are included in all-online flows
assumptions.sizing_envelope: Rack and row demands, full circuit main flow, and equipment duty division by minimum surviving units in each independent pod or plant bank. A fully isolated pod has unresolved CDU duty; flow/loss screens then cover surviving-unit cases only. These maxima do not represent one solved operating network.
assumptions.equipment: CDU and chiller allocations apply independently to each fluid side; rack allocation represents aggregate IT-side loss
assumptions.flexibility: Default hose K=0 is an explicit unverified placeholder; hose/QD vendor curves remain required
assumptions.scope: No pump-curve intersection, pressure balancing, controls stability, operating redundancy, NPSH, cavitation, transient, or certified capacity assessment

preliminary_sizing.scope: Manual commercial pipe sizes retained; flow, pressure loss, pump head and valve duties evaluated at those bores. Prescribed-flow estimates, not a balanced network solution.

connectivity_scenarios.scope: Undirected external fluid-path reachability with selected component edges removed. Required cases include all configured simultaneous CDU outages; additional single-equipment isolation cases are diagnostic. Does not establish flow, pressure, capacity, controls or operational redundancy. Plant availability lists are counts, not proof of complete plant operation.

checks.check: TCS supply above room dew point + 2 K

checks.detail: Applies to the declared measured/design room dew point; no room humidity simulation.

checks.source: ASHRAE-6 §6.1
checks.detail: IT manufacturer must qualify the equipment for the selected class; this is a boundary input check.

checks.source: ASHRAE-5/6
checks.detail: Required approach/capacity must be checked using the actual CDU curve, fluids and flows.

checks.source: ASHRAE-5 §5.1
checks.detail: FWS W-class is independent of TCS S-class; no fixed W-to-S conversion is applied.

checks.check: CDU return-side temperature approach is positive
checks.source: ASHRAE-5/6
checks.detail: Boundary temperatures must permit heat transfer at both ends. Actual heat exchanger approach remains vendor-specific.

checks.source: ASHRAE-7 §7.4
checks.detail: Commonly used materials are not a compatibility endorsement.

checks.check: CDU and plant capacity / minimum flow
checks.source: ASHRAE-5 §5.2
checks.detail: No pump head, pressure distribution, transient or hydraulic capacity is solved.

checks.check: Cooling pod 1 CDUs stand with the rows they serve
checks.required: no more than 2 m clear of the rows
checks.source: ASHRAE-2 §2.1.5
checks.detail: Clear distance along the hall between this pod's CDU gallery and the rows it feeds. cdu_placement selects the gallery: central_gallery stands each pod's CDUs alongside its own rows.

guidance.scope: Scoped guidance and declared-input review; not installation certification

checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: Every direction change needs an explicit fitting or declared equipment port direction.

checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: Diameter changes must occur inside an explicit reducer.

checks.check: Bore changes stay inside a reducing fitting
checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: Only a concentric/eccentric reducer or an ASME B16.9 reducing tee may hold two bores. A pipe, elbow or valve is one size end to end.

checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: FWS, CWS and independent TCS pods cannot share a fluid connection.

checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: Only declared boundary interfaces may be open.

checks.check: Bend takeoff exceeds insulated outer radius
checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: No miter replacement or silent radius reduction is permitted. A commercial long-radius elbow is 1.5 nominal diameters, larger again than this geometric minimum.

checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: Conservative finite centerline segments with OD, insulation and configured clear gap. Component bodies/vendor envelopes remain separately qualified.

checks.source: Physical graph geometry
checks.detail: Pipe and fitting envelopes include insulation. Contact at an explicitly connected equipment port is permitted; vendor service/transport requirements still require qualification.
